$comment: THE ACCEPTED STATE OF THE WEEK, so scripts/gym-coverage.mjs can tell a regression from a
Until this file existed, that script exited 1 on every single run, and the handoff that shipped
it said so and called it correct: 11 of 16 muscles are past the efficient zone and four
exercises carry no source, all known, all accepted. A gate that is expected to fail teaches
everyone to ignore it, and it cannot get redder. Pushing a muscle BELOW its minimum dose, or
adding a strict Zhang violation, would not have changed the exit code by one bit.
So the exit code compares against this file. Three lists, and each is a state nobody has ever
belowMinimum   a muscle under 4 fractional sets a week. Pelland 2026's own floor.
strictPairs    a partner whose main muscle IS the lead lift's main muscle. Zhang 2025.
unsourced      an exercise in the week with no basis recorded anywhere.
PAST THE EFFICIENT ZONE IS DELIBERATELY NOT GATED. It is diminishing returns, not harm, and 11
muscles are there today. `perMuscle` below is a snapshot for the diff, not a rule: every run
prints which muscles moved and by how much since this file was stamped, which is what makes a
pairing change quotable as a number instead of an intention.
TO CHANGE IT: `node scripts/gym-coverage.mjs --accept`. It REFUSES while a regression is
present unless `--accept-regression` is also passed, so silencing a new below-minimum muscle
cannot happen by reflex. The git diff of this file is the whole record of what was accepted.
acceptedBecause: the week rebuilt 2026-10-04 on his words ("rebuild everything based on what I can do"), sized to his measured pace. The three GATED lists were empty before and are empty now: no muscle under 4 fractional sets, no strict Zhang pairing, no unsourced exercise. perMuscle moved down on most upper-body muscles and the quadriceps because the card went from 27 sets to 16 and 15, sized so 3 in 4 of his days land at or under 80 minutes. Side deltoids and calves sit exactly at the floor of 4, and abs, triceps, front deltoids, biceps and rear deltoids at 5, so the next cut to any of them fails this gate.
